# GitHub Social Preview — VOS

**语言中立：** tagline 与 prompt 不得出现编程语言名、logo、后缀或典型语法片段。

File: [`social-preview.jpg`](./social-preview.jpg) — **1280×640**, target &lt; 500 KB (must be **&lt; 1 MB**).

## Upload

1. [Settings → Social preview](https://github.com/voml/vos-language/settings#social-preview)
2. Upload **`.github/social-preview.jpg`**

## Layout brief

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Size | 1280×640 (2:1，GenerateImage 后 cover 裁切) |
| Tagline | Schema-first language for structured data |
| Primary | `#047857` reliable green |
| Energy | `#6EE7B7` mint |
| Background | deep `#0a1f17` |
| Mood | dark poster, structured, trustworthy |

**构图：** 左文右图。右侧中心 hub 向外辐射的 schema 节点星座，mint 高光，绿色 glow。

## Image prompt (English)

```
Ultra-wide banner, central 89% safe zone for 2:1 crop. Dark poster #0a1f17, reliable green #047857 glow.

LEFT: "VOS", "Schema-first language for structured data".

RIGHT: radial schema constellation — large central hub, connected type nodes radiating outward, mint #6EE7B7 highlights, depth via glow.

No programming language names or logos.
```
